# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

These picks come from the guides I found. Prices move often, so check the current price before you buy.

**Best overall value: EarFun Air Pro 4**
- Soundmavericks ranks it #1 under $150 for its adaptive ANC (SoundGuys measured about 80% ambient noise reduction), LDAC/aptX Lossless, wireless charging, and 7.5 hrs of battery with ANC on.
- [Soundmavericks guide, with Amazon link](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

**Best noise cancelling on any phone: Nothing Ear (3)**
- SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint, and wireless charging, and costs just under $150 on Amazon. The drawbacks are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hrs per charge.
- [iTech Level guide](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) and [SlashGear guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best deal right now: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro**
- It lists at $149.99. Dealectric's tested code **AFSC20** brings it to about **$120** (last cart-tested Oct 22).
- It has good ANC for the price, LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging, and IPX5 water resistance.
- [Buy link (Soundcore's US store via Dealectric, an affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). Confirm the code at checkout.

**Best for Android/Samsung: Galaxy Buds3 Pro**
- About $134 new from Samsung's Amazon store, with great adaptive ANC, IPX7, and 18 hrs of battery with the case.
- [SlashGear guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (previous gen)**
- SlashGear says renewed pairs are often on sale for around $150 or less. They have excellent ANC and transparency mode, but you lose some features on Android.
- [SlashGear guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best Sony option: WF-C710N**
- What Hi-Fi's best budget pick, listed at $119 at Walmart. It has 8.5 hrs of battery with ANC on, but no LDAC.
- [What Hi-Fi guide](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)

**If you want to spend less: Soundcore P31i**
- $59.99 with adaptive ANC, multipoint, and IP55. Its ANC is weaker, but it's good value.
- [SlashGear guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

## Quick advice
- **Android:** the EarFun Air Pro 4 or Nothing Ear (3), or the Galaxy Buds3 Pro if you have a Samsung phone.
- **iPhone:** a sale-priced AirPods Pro 2.
- **Lowest price for strong ANC:** the Liberty 4 Pro with the code.
- **Strongest ANC overall:** the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Gen 2 and Sony WF-1000XM6 are the best, but at $270-$330 they're well over your budget ([What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)).

I couldn't open the retailer pages directly, so apart from the Liberty 4 Pro, the links go to the review guides that carry the buy buttons. Tell me whether you use iPhone or Android and I can narrow it down.
